hook: In 1881, Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet didn't span a full week.

sections.voiceover: In 1881, Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet didn't span a full week.
sections.visual_cue: Historical vintage clock face overlaying an antique Victorian map of London.
sections.sfx_cue: Dramatic low ambient drone with clock ticking
b_roll: Victorian London street scene in fog
sections.animation_cue: Slow slow zoom into vintage pocket watch

sections.voiceover: Watson returned wounded from the Battle of Maiwand in Afghanistan. The timeline of this investigation ran from 4 March to 7 March 1881. Where was this 1881 story first published?
sections.visual_cue: Public domain illustration of British military campaign in Afghanistan moving to Victorian manuscript page.
sections.sfx_cue: Paper page turn followed by subtle tension swell
sections.animation_cue: Pan across handwritten dates on old parchment

sections.voiceover: But Arthur Conan Doyle didn't publish A Study in Scarlet until years after 1881.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of vintage ink pen resting beside an unpublished manuscript bundle.
b_roll: Victorian writing desk with oil lamp
sections.animation_cue: Push in on manuscript title page

sections.voiceover: The novel first appeared in Beeton's Christmas Annual in 1887. Ward, Lock & Co. published the first British book edition in 1888. The research site ChronoHolmes confirms the investigation spanned 4 days in March 1881.
sections.visual_cue: Archive print cover of Beeton's Christmas Annual transitioning to the 1888 Ward, Lock & Co. book cover.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle cinematic riser to triumphant resolution string note
b_roll: 1888 Ward Lock and Co book edition cover
sections.animation_cue: Split screen comparing 1887 publication cover to 1888 book edition

sections.voiceover: That 1881 timeline established the legacy of Sherlock Holmes.
sections.visual_cue: Silhouette illustration of Sherlock Holmes with magnifying glass over historical Baker Street map.
b_roll: Victorian London 221B Baker Street historical sign
vintage silhouette portrait of Sherlock Holmes
sections.animation_cue: Slow fade out on vintage Holmes silhouette
